description: Layer 1 COMBO: wires the canonical 2026 AI-mirror installation in one MCP call — camera (or synthetic / existing TOP) → StreamDiffusion (img2img live, delegated to drive_streamdiffusion) → Syphon/Spout/NDI/internal output → a prompt+strength+cfg control panel whose sliders and textDATs drive SD pars via .expr expressions. Panel only binds pars present in drive_streamdiffusion's validated_pars; missing pars are warned, not errored. Camera source on macOS triggers the OS permission dialog on first cook; fallback_to_synthetic keeps the rig alive when the camera is unavailable.

camera_device_idx.description: USB camera device index when source='camera'.

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale; SD sweet spot 1–2.

expose_control_panel.description: Build the prompt+sliders panel and wire .expr expressions to SD pars.

fallback_to_synthetic.description: If camera creation fails, build a synthetic noise source instead of aborting.

output_mode.description: Output: syphon_spout (macOS/Windows showcase form), ndi (cross-host), or internal (no sender).

show_camera_preview.description: Add a small selectTOP preview of the camera inside the panel.

source.description: Input source: USB camera (hype default), self-animated synthetic TOP, or an existing TOP routed through a Select.

strength.description: img2img mix; surfaced in the panel.

name: create_ai_mirror
title: Create AI Mirror
